text:
alex: Quick sync — we're proposing a small contract change on /v1/generate: 1) change default model from 'redwood-v1' -> 'redwood-v2' 2) add optional `response_format` param (text|json). Plan: deprecate old default in 8 weeks, clients get fallback for pinned models. Will this break clients? Need quick thumbs + any rollout concerns. @mira @jas

mira: Short answer: changing default is breaking for unpinned clients that implicitly relied on v1 semantics. Recommend a server-side compatibility shim that preserves v1-like tokenization/metadata for requests that opt-in via header for the deprecation window. Also send a deprecation header to surface to SDKs.

jas: +1. Also we should add `Accept-Model` header support so SDKs and infra can explicitly opt into redwood-v2. Example: `Accept-Model: redwood-v2`.

olivia: Ops note: if we change default, monitoring must flag latency/regression differences between v1 and v2. Can we run a 48h canary and compare p95/p99? :eyes:

kevin: From SDK side we can auto-pin to the current default for 6 months (configurable). Need clear docs and a migration guide for customers.

alex: Proposal: implement server fallback for unpinned callers that still want v1 behavior. Behavior idea: if no `model` param and no `Accept-Model` header, return v2 but set deprecation headers so SDKs can detect change. Pseudocode:

```
if (!model && !Accept-Model) {
  model = defaultModel; // redwood-v2
  res.setHeader('X-Default-Version', 'redwood-v2');
  res.setHeader('X-Deprecation-Notice', 'default model will change on 2026-05-10');
}
```

mira: OK but ensure customer-specified `model` or pinned accounts always override. Also provide a `X-Compat-Mode: v1` header for requests routed through the shim so we can metric compatibility usage separately.

deploy-bot: CI: integration-tests passed against v2 with fuzz tests. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: Add rollback playbook: if error rate or latency delta > threshold (suggested 1% errors or +30% p99), automatically route unpinned traffic back to redwood-v1 cluster and page the oncall.

jas: Also request we introduce `Accept-Response-Format: json` header so new clients can request structured outputs. Servers should keep default to `text` to avoid breaking existing parsers.

alex: Draft timeline (proposal):
- week 1: feature flag + header support (`Accept-Model`, `Accept-Response-Format`, deprecation headers)
- week 2: 1% canary for power-users + smoke monitoring
- week 4: 10% canary + doc PR + SDK pinning PRs
- week 6: public deprecation comms to unpinned users + migration guide email
- week 8: flip default to redwood-v2 for unpinned traffic
- week 12: evaluate and, if stable for 4 weeks, remove v1 fallback

mira: +1 with one condition: do not remove fallback until 4 weeks of stability post-flip (so effectively week 16 for removal unless we see issues).

kevin: I'll draft the SDK pinning PR and migration guide. Will post links here when ready.

alex: Great. I'll make a rollout checklist + runbook and open a PR for the header impl. Ping here if you spot blockers. :thumbsup:
